name: 远程工作台
iconSvg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect width="20" height="14" x="2" y="3" rx="2"/><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="21" y2="21"/><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="17" y2="21"/><path d="m7 8 2 2-2 2"/><path d="M12 12h4"/></svg>
description: 多主机资产管理与 Web SSH 远程交互终端：统一共享 global-hosts.json 配置源，具备画布分屏矩阵查看（标签/双列/四格/自适应画布）、多机广播同步输入、AI 批处理执行工具、Sudo 外带凭据直通、ANSI 噪音折叠、~/.ssh/config 发现导入、轻量 SFTP 树浏览与端口转发能力。
descriptionEn: Multi-host inventory & Web SSH terminal: shares unified global-hosts.json, equipped with canvas/grid terminal dashboard, cluster broadcast input, AI execution tool, out-of-band credential prompt, ANSI compaction, ~/.ssh/config discovery, lightweight SFTP explorer, and port forwarding.
